decks.name: LeetCode #242 - Valid Anagram
decks.description: Check if two strings are anagrams of each other

cards.question: Valid Anagram: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An anagram is a word formed by rearranging the letters of another word using all original letters exactly once.

solutions.name: Hash Table (Array)
solutions.explanation: Use a fixed-size array of 26 integers to count character frequencies. Increment for characters in s, decrement for characters in t. If all counts are zero, strings are anagrams. Most space-efficient for lowercase letters.

solutions.name: Hash Map (Two Dictionaries)
solutions.explanation: Count the frequency of each character in both strings using separate hash maps, then compare the two maps. If they are equal, the strings are anagrams.

solutions.name: Sorting
solutions.explanation: Sort both strings and compare them. If sorted strings are equal, they are anagrams. Simple but less efficient due to sorting overhead.
